verdict.rationale: monday.com's first-party docs explicitly say developers can 'use our flexible APIs, SDKs to build custom apps'. They also describe a code-first apps framework, Vibe open-source React components, a GraphQL API, and programmatic control of agents from your own code. Together these show an official build-against surface, though the SDK claims themselves are high-level. Missing for 10: named SDK packages and supported languages, in-depth SDK reference documentation, and independent or hands-on corroboration of SDK usage.
